description.text: Training objectives: This program aims to cultivate students who can adapt to the new requirements of globalization, get familiar with the complex environment of international business, serve the needs of national economic and social development, obtain a complete international business knowledge system, familiarize themselves with international business laws and usual practices, and build up strong international business practice capabilities and cross-cultural business communication skills, and finally turn them into international business talents who are competent for international business analysis, operation, management and decision-making in foreign-related enterprises, social institutions, and government departments.Program features: Beijing Language and Culture University (BLCU), also known as the "Little United Nations", is one of the leading universities in China enjoying a great reputation for providing students with a multi-language, multi-cultural, and international environment of study. With the advantages of the above, Program of MIB builds a brand of “Study in China” by offering bilingual teaching, Sino-foreign integration, and Chinese cultural experiences. By leveraging the benefits of multi-disciplinary education system of BLCU and the locational advantage of College Road Community, the Program of MIB lays emphasis on the interdisciplinary teaching, integration of education with industry and practical teaching, strengthening collaborative education and aiming at cultivating qualified international business talents with proficient language abilities, professional knowledge, and highly specialized skills.Cultivation directions: International Trade and Cross-Border InvestmentInternational Trade: To meet the national development needs, by utilizing resources from both the university and society, and combining classroom teachings with professional practices, this program aims at cultivating international business talents with sufficient knowledge of international trade theory, international trade practice skills and relevant laws and usual practices, strong English communication skills, who can adapt to the once-in-a-century challenging and complicated international economic, political, and cultural environment.Cross-border Investment: Combined with the advantages of the "Little United Nations" of BLCU, the program offers all courses in English, and provides an environment of multicultural communication and comprehensive practices, to produce qualified talents that are familiar with international business rules, fluent in English and capable of cross-cultural communication, and that can engage in transnational operations and investment management in the complex international business environment, and deal with economic frictions, cultural conflicts, and investment risks with ease.Target of enrollment: International students with Chinese and foreign undergraduate degrees and equivalent academic qualifications from universities in the national education sequence.

duration.text: The International Business at Beijing Language and Culture University is a 2 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3222 USD/per year ￥ 23200 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Application Form for Chinese Government Scholarship (in Chinese or English), please follow step 1 in Application Procedure to download the form and upload according to step 2 in Application Procedure;2.Copy of Passport Home Page. If the validity of the applicant’s current passport does not meet the requirement (meaning the passport expires before March 2026), please apply for a new passport before submitting the application;3.Notarized highest diploma (Bachelor or higher). Prospective diploma winners must submit official proof of student status by their current school. Documents in languages other than Chinese or English must be attached with notarized Chinese or English translations;4.Academic transcripts (from the undergraduate program onwards). Copies of academic records from first to last semester during the undergraduate. They can be written in Chinese or English, but must be attached with notarized English translations if they are in foreign languages other than English;5.English proficiency certificate: IELTS score of 6 (no less than 5.5 of each section)/TOEFL score of 90 or English native speaker;6.A study plan proposal (written in English, no less than 1,000 words);7.Recommendation letters. Two letters of recommendation from professors or associate professors shall be submitted. They can be written in Chinese or English, but must be attached with notarized English translations if they are in foreign languages other than English;8.A photocopy of the Foreigner Physical Examination Form completed in English (the original copy shall be kept by the applicant). The form is designed by the Chinese quarantine authority and can be obtained from the dispatching authority. The physical examinations must cover all the items listed in the Foreigner Physical Examination Form. Incomplete records or those without the signature of the attending physician, the official stamp of the hospital, or a sealed photograph of the applicants are invalid. Please select the appropriate time to take a physical examination as the result is valid for only 6 months.9.Non-criminal record report. The applicant shall submit a valid certificate of Non-Criminal Record issued by the local public security authority, usually issued within 6 months prior to the submission date of the application.

requirements.text: 1.Applicants must be a citizen of a country other than the People’s Republic of China, and be in good mental and physical health.2.The requirements for applicants’ degree and age are that applicants must be a bachelor’s degree holder and no more than 35 years old when applying for the master’s programs.3.Other kinds of Chinese Government Scholarships are not obtained at the same time.4. Eligible Countries for Application: Kazakhstan, Uzbekistan, Kyrgyzstan, Russia, Mongolia, Georgia, Turkey, Italy, Indonesia, Thailand.
